contract: Every stage that reads repository content runs inside an immutable checkout of the pushed SHA (tree: pushed-sha). A stage with tree none reads only the pushed ref lines or a remote signal. The working tree is never a proof input; a manual invocation gates HEAD. The identity the gate proves is exported to every stage under the environment names below and printed once by the identity line.

stages.proves: the pushed ref lines are read; the first local sha is the tree under proof

a push that requests the data-only path is exactly one fast-forward of main that only appends measuring records to data/formation-health/trend.ndjson, proved by that trend's owner (the working tree's scripts/checks/formation-health.js: its exit status and its verified line); any other shape is refused, never gated or fast-pathed instead
a push of only tags or proof receipts for commits already on origin/main introduces no tree, and a receipt must not re-enter the gate that records it
the latest completed ci run on main is green or exempted at its exact head
the pushed sha is checked out once into a throwaway worktree with the workspace injections declared; every later stage runs there
the checkout's HEAD is the pushed sha and the remote base is the change proof's base
eslint over the JavaScript the pushed range adds or changes, or over every tracked file when there is no range or the lint contract itself changed
duplication and file-size ratchets over the whole pushed tree
no short stage mutated tracked content
the machine has headroom before the long stage
the focused contracts, the audits and the change proof (or the whole corpus) against the remote base
